bullets.text: The Spurs have won 12 straight and the Lakers 8 straight, leaving both at 12-2 atop the West.
The Bucks and Jazz are both 1-13 and the Kings are 1-12, with Milwaukee on 10 straight losses and Utah on 12.
The 76ers lead the East Atlantic at 12-3 on a +42 point differential, while the Celtics sit just behind at 11-3 with a +161 mark.
